Israil men kiski sarkar banegi, ise lekar gatirodh bana huaa hai. mangalvar ko israil ki sansad men shapath grahan samaroh aayojit huaa, lekin naee sarkar ke gathan par batchit abhi bhi jari hai.aam chunav men binyamin netanyahu ko bahumat nahin mil saka. vahin unke mukhy pratidvandviyon ke pas bhi satta tak pahunchne ka koee saf rasta nahin hai. is bich israili midiya men kaisi charcha hai, dekhie yah vidiyo.
